Punch.name: diffuse_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Base diffuse/color texture; RGB and alpha use are source/state-specific.

Punch.name: diffuse_uv_set
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Per-map UV selector for diffuse_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

Punch.name: environment_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original reflection/environment input as sampler2D. Its projection is recorded per shader: sphere, dual sphere, or 4x3 cross. Bind the matching representation; it is independent from sky_panorama.

Punch.name: diffuse_color
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original numeric material diffuse RGBA. RGB tints the source-specific direct/surface response; ambient tinting differs by game/variant. W participates only where the selected alpha expression uses it. Preserve authored values, including 0.6.

Punch.name: specular_color
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original numeric material specular RGBA. RGB weights source specular and/or reflection terms as shown in this shader. Do not apply an sRGB color-picker conversion.

Punch.name: power_gloss_level
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original numeric g_PowerGlossLevel vector; name is intentionally unchanged. Y controls exponent and Z controls applicable Generations intensity. Other used lanes are variant-defined; see expressions. This is not the renamed gloss texture.

Punch.name: material_opacity
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original material opacity factor retained only when source coverage needs it in Punch/Trans. It does not turn an opaque shader transparent. Default 1; combine with texture/material alpha according to the listed expression.

Punch.name: luminance_range
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original environment HDR decode factor: sampled RGB is increased by RGB * sampled alpha * luminance_range in variants using that encoding. Zero disables the encoded extra range, not the base reflection.

Punch.name: alpha_cutoff
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Punch-only discard threshold, default 0.502. Source material alpha below this is discarded; surviving pixels have full coverage. Not present in Opaque or Trans.

Punch.name: uv0_offset
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV0 before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. These are texture coordinates, not pixels.

Punch.name: uv1_offset
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV1 (Godot UV2) before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. UV1 must exist in the mesh.

Punch.name: use_gi_atlas
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Common material switch: false (default) uses actual foundation panorama light-field behavior; true selects the source baked-GI atlas branch. Bind valid GI texture/UV/decode data before enabling.

Punch.name: gi_atlas
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Source baked-GI texture, sampled only in the selected GI branch. Not an environment reflection map. Requires the original atlas coordinates and encoding controls for correct static lighting.

Punch.name: gi_uv_scale
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Scale of the GI UV coordinates before atlas sampling. Default (1,1); independent of diffuse/normal/gloss selectors.

Punch.name: gi_uv_offset
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Offset of the GI UV coordinates after scale. Default (0,0); bind original surface atlas rectangle offset.

Punch.name: gi_rgb_scale
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original baked-GI RGB decode scale after source squaring/saturation operations. Default (1,1,1). It is not a general material brightness fix.

fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: gi_saturation
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original baked-GI grayscale/color interpolation control. Default 1 keeps source chroma; see exact coefficients and clamp in the shader.

fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: sky_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation upper-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; used by actual panorama/light-field or rim helpers where present.

Punch.name: ground_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation lower-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; not an original numeric HE1 material vector.

Punch.name: ambient_light_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation ambient color in lit materials (color picker). A declaration without hint_color is a numeric source-use specialization; the exact declaration and uses below take precedence. Not Godot Environment ambient by itself.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;
fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: sky_panorama
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation 2D panorama used by its five-sample light-field and reflected-direction rim functions. This input is distinct from environment_texture and is not a 4x3 cubemap cross.

Punch.name: ambient_light_sky_contribution
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation interpolation weight mixing supplied ambient with sampled panorama/sky/ground. Use the actual foundation function, including brightness floor and clamp; it is not a generic scene-light intensity.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;

Punch.name: inner_shadow_amount
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation region-shadow strength inside the region; default 1. Applied through compute_shadow and the texture/box mask. With no valid region the shader bypasses this shadow.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: outer_shadow_amount
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation region-shadow strength outside the region; default 0. Not the native DirectionalLight shadow strength.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: inner_min
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation local shadow-region lower bounds, clamped componentwise to [-1,0] in sdBox. Default (-1,-1,-1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: inner_max
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation local shadow-region upper bounds, clamped componentwise to [0,1] in sdBox. Default (1,1,1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: shadow_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation region shadow mask. Red is inverted in sdBox; bind together with the region transform/bounds. Not an HE1 shadow-register dump or an automatically generated engine shadow map.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: region_transform
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation region-to-world transform consumed by compute_shadow. Supply it only for a functioning region-shadow setup; a degenerate axis bypasses the region. It is a real mandatory integration input when that system is used.

compute_shadow: vec3 region_axis_length = vec3(length(region_transform[0]), length(region_transform[1]), length(region_transform[2]));
p = (p - region_transform[3].xyz) * mat3(region_transform);

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original fragment radiance terms add before output transfer. Retain the actual foundation individual squares and add the exact pairwise interaction terms between equally weighted fragment contributions: ['2.0 * ambient * reflected']. This localized source-backed composition matches the user-identified 15:03 fragment checkpoint. Native light(), fake_specular transfer, per-light compensation, panorama/region helpers and vertex processing are unchanged. No native accumulator recovery or final-output compatibility square is introduced.

source_review: Actual foundation region shadow, custom light(), compute_fresnel cache and fake_specular block retained. Source Common uses unwrapped Lambert and no separate rim lobe; packed material normal decoding is retained when sampled.
The paired Unleashed Default vertex uses 0.3 + 0.7*(1-saturate(NdotV))^5, distinct from SSS Luminescence endpoints and the Generations Default endpoints.

GI atlas encoded RGB is squared before saturation and g_GI0Scale.rgb * g_Ambient.rgb multiplication. Source material diffuse tint affects direct diffuse only; atlas ambient uses texture and vertex RGB without material diffuse tint.
Source P=clamp(power.r*exp2(material.y*10+2),1,512), gain=P/8; source without power map uses 1 and still has material-colored specular. Vertex COLOR modulates diffuse RGB/alpha, not specular.
Original opacity multiplies texture/material/vertex alpha. No emission source or unused emission uniforms retained.
This source has no environment sampler; no environment interface is added.
Original per-light shadow-map selection remains a renderer boundary; preserve established PRR region and native-light integration rather than introducing unbound HE1 constants.
No independent specular RGB map is sampled.
No projected scene reflection sampler.

For absent exact HLSL filenames, a related supplied HLSL is only a readable scaffold. Per-variant original Xbox ASM controls sampler presence, material COLOR absence, additional operations and independent numerical reference tests.

User-requested Common use_gi_atlas defaults false: reuse the actual foundation five-sample panorama and region-only direct shadow. True selects the preserved original baked branch. Material, specular, reflection and per-contribution transfer equations remain shared.

Linked original vertex stages negate the authored BINORMAL before interpolation. Apply BINORMAL = -BINORMAL once before foundation basis caching; keep the original normal decoder and texture unchanged. Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Opaque.description: Foundation upper-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; used by actual panorama/light-field or rim helpers where present.

Opaque.name: ground_color
Opaque.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Opaque.description: Foundation lower-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; not an original numeric HE1 material vector.

Opaque.name: ambient_light_color
Opaque.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Opaque.description: Foundation ambient color in lit materials (color picker). A declaration without hint_color is a numeric source-use specialization; the exact declaration and uses below take precedence. Not Godot Environment ambient by itself.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;
fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Opaque.name: sky_panorama
Opaque.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Opaque.description: Foundation 2D panorama used by its five-sample light-field and reflected-direction rim functions. This input is distinct from environment_texture and is not a 4x3 cubemap cross.

Opaque.name: ambient_light_sky_contribution
Opaque.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Opaque.description: Foundation interpolation weight mixing supplied ambient with sampled panorama/sky/ground. Use the actual foundation function, including brightness floor and clamp; it is not a generic scene-light intensity.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;

Opaque.name: inner_shadow_amount
Opaque.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Opaque.description: Foundation region-shadow strength inside the region; default 1. Applied through compute_shadow and the texture/box mask. With no valid region the shader bypasses this shadow.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Opaque.name: outer_shadow_amount
Opaque.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Opaque.description: Foundation region-shadow strength outside the region; default 0. Not the native DirectionalLight shadow strength.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Opaque.name: inner_min
Opaque.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Opaque.description: Foundation local shadow-region lower bounds, clamped componentwise to [-1,0] in sdBox. Default (-1,-1,-1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Opaque.name: inner_max
Opaque.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Opaque.description: Foundation local shadow-region upper bounds, clamped componentwise to [0,1] in sdBox. Default (1,1,1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Opaque.name: shadow_texture
Opaque.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Opaque.description: Foundation region shadow mask. Red is inverted in sdBox; bind together with the region transform/bounds. Not an HE1 shadow-register dump or an automatically generated engine shadow map.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Opaque.name: region_transform
Opaque.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Opaque.description: Foundation region-to-world transform consumed by compute_shadow. Supply it only for a functioning region-shadow setup; a degenerate axis bypasses the region. It is a real mandatory integration input when that system is used.

compute_shadow: vec3 region_axis_length = vec3(length(region_transform[0]), length(region_transform[1]), length(region_transform[2]));
p = (p - region_transform[3].xyz) * mat3(region_transform);

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

source_review: Actual foundation region shadow, custom light(), compute_fresnel cache and fake_specular block retained. Source Common uses unwrapped Lambert and no separate rim lobe; packed material normal decoding is retained when sampled.
The paired Unleashed Default vertex uses 0.3 + 0.7*(1-saturate(NdotV))^5, distinct from SSS Luminescence endpoints and the Generations Default endpoints.

GI atlas encoded RGB is squared before saturation and g_GI0Scale.rgb * g_Ambient.rgb multiplication. Source material diffuse tint affects direct diffuse only; atlas ambient uses texture and vertex RGB without material diffuse tint.
Source P=clamp(power.r*exp2(material.y*10+2),1,512), gain=P/8; source without power map uses 1 and still has material-colored specular. Vertex COLOR modulates diffuse RGB/alpha, not specular.
Original opacity multiplies texture/material/vertex alpha. No emission source or unused emission uniforms retained.

Environment lookup uses the source world reflection vector: cube for samplerCUBE, otherwise the source dual-paraboloid 2D mapping. Decode RGB*(1+alpha*luminance_range), multiply the sampled power mask when present, geometric vertex Fresnel and (0.3+0.7*direct_shadow). Source ambient/reflection addition preserves the established same-fragment transfer.
Original per-light shadow-map selection remains a renderer boundary; preserve established PRR region and native-light integration rather than introducing unbound HE1 constants.
No independent specular RGB map is sampled.
No projected scene reflection sampler.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original fragment radiance terms add before output transfer. Retain the actual foundation individual squares and add the exact pairwise interaction terms between equally weighted fragment contributions: ['2.0 * ambient * reflected']. This localized source-backed composition matches the user-identified 15:03 fragment checkpoint. Native light(), fake_specular transfer, per-light compensation, panorama/region helpers and vertex processing are unchanged. No native accumulator recovery or final-output compatibility square is introduced.

Punch.name: environment_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original reflection/environment input as sampler2D. Its projection is recorded per shader: sphere, dual sphere, or 4x3 cross. Bind the matching representation; it is independent from sky_panorama.

Punch.name: diffuse_color
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original numeric material diffuse RGBA. RGB tints the source-specific direct/surface response; ambient tinting differs by game/variant. W participates only where the selected alpha expression uses it. Preserve authored values, including 0.6.

Punch.name: specular_color
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original numeric material specular RGBA. RGB weights source specular and/or reflection terms as shown in this shader. Do not apply an sRGB color-picker conversion.

Punch.name: power_gloss_level
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original numeric g_PowerGlossLevel vector; name is intentionally unchanged. Y controls exponent and Z controls applicable Generations intensity. Other used lanes are variant-defined; see expressions. This is not the renamed gloss texture.

Punch.name: material_opacity
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original material opacity factor retained only when source coverage needs it in Punch/Trans. It does not turn an opaque shader transparent. Default 1; combine with texture/material alpha according to the listed expression.

Punch.name: luminance_range
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original environment HDR decode factor: sampled RGB is increased by RGB * sampled alpha * luminance_range in variants using that encoding. Zero disables the encoded extra range, not the base reflection.

Punch.name: alpha_cutoff
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Punch-only discard threshold, default 0.502. Source material alpha below this is discarded; surviving pixels have full coverage. Not present in Opaque or Trans.

Punch.name: uv0_offset
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV0 before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. These are texture coordinates, not pixels.

Punch.name: uv1_offset
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV1 (Godot UV2) before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. UV1 must exist in the mesh.

Punch.name: use_gi_atlas
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Common material switch: false (default) uses actual foundation panorama light-field behavior; true selects the source baked-GI atlas branch. Bind valid GI texture/UV/decode data before enabling.

Punch.name: gi_atlas
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Source baked-GI texture, sampled only in the selected GI branch. Not an environment reflection map. Requires the original atlas coordinates and encoding controls for correct static lighting.

Punch.name: gi_uv_scale
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Scale of the GI UV coordinates before atlas sampling. Default (1,1); independent of diffuse/normal/gloss selectors.

Punch.name: gi_uv_offset
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Offset of the GI UV coordinates after scale. Default (0,0); bind original surface atlas rectangle offset.

Punch.name: gi_rgb_scale
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original baked-GI RGB decode scale after source squaring/saturation operations. Default (1,1,1). It is not a general material brightness fix.

fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: gi_saturation

Punch.name: ambient_light_color

Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation local shadow-region upper bounds, clamped componentwise to [0,1] in sdBox. Default (1,1,1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: shadow_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation region shadow mask. Red is inverted in sdBox; bind together with the region transform/bounds. Not an HE1 shadow-register dump or an automatically generated engine shadow map.

Punch.name: region_transform
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.

Opaque.name: shadow_texture

Opaque.name: region_transform

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Directional cube lookup represented by a 4x3 DX horizontal-cross sampler2D. Supplied-image tiles match original DDS faces without rotation or mirroring. Face-local analytic derivatives select original cube mip levels; per-level half-texel bounds avoid neighboring atlas cells. environment_max_lod is sampler metadata, defaulting safely to base-only when no mip chain is supplied.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original fragment radiance terms add before output transfer. Retain the actual foundation individual squares and add the exact pairwise interaction terms between equally weighted fragment contributions: ['2.0 * ambient * reflected']. This localized source-backed composition matches the user-identified 15:03 fragment checkpoint. Native light(), fake_specular transfer, per-light compensation, panorama/region helpers and vertex processing are unchanged. No native accumulator recovery or final-output compatibility square is introduced.

get_rim_light_color.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

compute_falloff.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

light.reason: Source diffuse uses saturate(N·L), replacing the template's +0.35 wrap. The original Blinn half vector and per-contribution square remain in Godot light(). Source camera specular, where present, also retains the actual foundation fake_specular block with matching material inputs.

source_review: Actual foundation region shadow, custom light(), compute_fresnel cache and fake_specular block retained. Source Common uses unwrapped Lambert and no separate rim lobe; packed material normal decoding is retained when sampled.
The paired Unleashed Default vertex uses 0.3 + 0.7*(1-saturate(NdotV))^5, distinct from SSS Luminescence endpoints and the Generations Default endpoints.

GI atlas encoded RGB is squared before saturation and g_GI0Scale.rgb * g_Ambient.rgb multiplication. Source material diffuse tint affects direct diffuse only; atlas ambient uses texture and vertex RGB without material diffuse tint.
Source P=clamp(power.r*exp2(material.y*10+2),1,512), gain=P/8; source without power map uses 1 and still has material-colored specular. Vertex COLOR modulates diffuse RGB/alpha, not specular.
Original opacity multiplies texture/material/vertex alpha. No emission source or unused emission uniforms retained.

Environment lookup uses the source world reflection vector: cube for samplerCUBE, otherwise the source dual-paraboloid 2D mapping. Decode RGB*(1+alpha*luminance_range), multiply the sampled power mask when present, geometric vertex Fresnel and (0.3+0.7*direct_shadow). Source ambient/reflection addition preserves the established same-fragment transfer.
Original per-light shadow-map selection remains a renderer boundary; preserve established PRR region and native-light integration rather than introducing unbound HE1 constants.
No independent specular RGB map is sampled.
No projected scene reflection sampler.

For absent exact HLSL filenames, a related supplied HLSL is only a readable scaffold. Per-variant original Xbox ASM controls sampler presence, material COLOR absence, additional operations and independent numerical reference tests.

User-requested Common use_gi_atlas defaults false: reuse the actual foundation five-sample panorama and region-only direct shadow. True selects the preserved original baked branch. Material, specular, reflection and per-contribution transfer equations remain shared.

Linked original vertex stages negate the authored BINORMAL before interpolation. Apply BINORMAL = -BINORMAL once before foundation basis caching; keep the original normal decoder and texture unchanged. Stage evidence: [{'source': 'he1shaders/unleashed hlsl/Default_@bnv@.wvu.hlsl', 'negated_input': 'v8', 'lines': [131, 133, 134, 139, 142]}, {'source': 'he1shaders/unleashed hlsl/Default_@bnv@p.wvu.hlsl', 'negated_input': 'v12', 'lines': [141, 142, 143, 152, 154]}]

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Directional cube lookup represented by a 4x3 DX horizontal-cross sampler2D. Supplied-image tiles match original DDS faces without rotation or mirroring. Face-local analytic derivatives select original cube mip levels; per-level half-texel bounds avoid neighboring atlas cells. environment_max_lod is sampler metadata, defaulting safely to base-only when no mip chain is supplied.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Original fragment radiance terms add before output transfer. Retain the actual foundation individual squares and add the exact pairwise interaction terms between equally weighted fragment contributions: ['2.0 * ambient * reflected']. This localized source-backed composition matches the user-identified 15:03 fragment checkpoint. Native light(), fake_specular transfer, per-light compensation, panorama/region helpers and vertex processing are unchanged. No native accumulator recovery or final-output compatibility square is introduced.

Unleashed/Common_dp@@.shader.name: Common_dp@@
source_operations: Actual foundation region shadow, custom light(), compute_fresnel cache and fake_specular block retained. Source Common uses unwrapped Lambert and no separate rim lobe; packed material normal decoding is retained when sampled.
The paired Unleashed Default vertex uses 0.3 + 0.7*(1-saturate(NdotV))^5, distinct from SSS Luminescence endpoints and the Generations Default endpoints.

GI atlas encoded RGB is squared before saturation and g_GI0Scale.rgb * g_Ambient.rgb multiplication. Source material diffuse tint affects direct diffuse only; atlas ambient uses texture and vertex RGB without material diffuse tint.
Source P=clamp(power.r*exp2(material.y*10+2),1,512), gain=P/8; source without power map uses 1 and still has material-colored specular. Vertex COLOR modulates diffuse RGB/alpha, not specular.
Original opacity multiplies texture/material/vertex alpha. No emission source or unused emission uniforms retained.
This source has no environment sampler; no environment interface is added.
Original per-light shadow-map selection remains a renderer boundary; preserve established PRR region and native-light integration rather than introducing unbound HE1 constants.
No independent specular RGB map is sampled.
No projected scene reflection sampler.

For absent exact HLSL filenames, a related supplied HLSL is only a readable scaffold. Per-variant original Xbox ASM controls sampler presence, material COLOR absence, additional operations and independent numerical reference tests.

User-requested Common use_gi_atlas defaults false: reuse the actual foundation five-sample panorama and region-only direct shadow. True selects the preserved original baked branch. Material, specular, reflection and per-contribution transfer equations remain shared.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

source_boundaries.rendering_boundary: Godot scene lights, PRR region shadows and panorama replace the HE1 scene registers. Original framebuffer cap and scattering are not reproduced.
source_boundaries.vertex_boundary: UV or UV2 remapping and native Godot skinning/blend shapes remain asset inputs.

get_rim_light_color.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

compute_falloff.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

decode_normal_map.reason: The source pixel body has no material normal sample. The linked vertex normal remains the surface basis.

light.reason: Source diffuse uses saturate(NÂ·L), replacing the template's +0.35 wrap. The original Blinn half vector and per-contribution square remain in Godot light(). Source camera specular, where present, also retains the actual foundation fake_specular block with matching material inputs.

source_correspondence.reason: Readable related HLSL is an analysis scaffold with source-absent power sampling removed. Exact original Xbox ASM defines this variant; source-operation tests execute that ASM rather than assuming scaffold equivalence. References below identify real files, not HLSL line numbers attributed to assembly.

Punch.name: diffuse_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Base diffuse/color texture; RGB and alpha use are source/state-specific.

Punch.name: diffuse_uv_set
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Per-map UV selector for diffuse_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

Punch.name: gloss_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original power/gloss map. This renamed sampler retains original channel/exponent/intensity use; eye variants can use multiple channels.

Punch.name: gloss_uv_set
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Per-map UV selector for gloss_texture: 0 = mesh UV0 (Godot UV), 1 = mesh UV1 (Godot UV2). Default 0; corresponding uv0_offset or uv1_offset is applied. No external UV data texture or channels 2/3 are required.

Punch.name: diffuse_color
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original numeric material diffuse RGBA. RGB tints the source-specific direct/surface response; ambient tinting differs by game/variant. W participates only where the selected alpha expression uses it. Preserve authored values, including 0.6.

Punch.name: specular_color
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original numeric material specular RGBA. RGB weights source specular and/or reflection terms as shown in this shader. Do not apply an sRGB color-picker conversion.

Punch.name: power_gloss_level
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Original numeric g_PowerGlossLevel vector; name is intentionally unchanged. Y controls exponent and Z controls applicable Generations intensity. Other used lanes are variant-defined; see expressions. This is not the renamed gloss texture.

Punch.name: material_opacity
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original material opacity factor retained only when source coverage needs it in Punch/Trans. It does not turn an opaque shader transparent. Default 1; combine with texture/material alpha according to the listed expression.

Punch.name: alpha_cutoff
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Punch-only discard threshold, default 0.502. Source material alpha below this is discarded; surviving pixels have full coverage. Not present in Opaque or Trans.

Punch.name: uv0_offset
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV0 before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. These are texture coordinates, not pixels.

Punch.name: uv1_offset
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: 2D offset added to mesh UV1 (Godot UV2) before per-texture channel selection. Default has no explicit initializer. UV1 must exist in the mesh.

Punch.name: use_gi_atlas
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Common material switch: false (default) uses actual foundation panorama light-field behavior; true selects the source baked-GI atlas branch. Bind valid GI texture/UV/decode data before enabling.

Punch.name: gi_atlas
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Source baked-GI texture, sampled only in the selected GI branch. Not an environment reflection map. Requires the original atlas coordinates and encoding controls for correct static lighting.

Punch.name: gi_uv_scale
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Scale of the GI UV coordinates before atlas sampling. Default (1,1); independent of diffuse/normal/gloss selectors.

Punch.name: gi_uv_offset
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Offset of the GI UV coordinates after scale. Default (0,0); bind original surface atlas rectangle offset.

Punch.name: gi_rgb_scale
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original baked-GI RGB decode scale after source squaring/saturation operations. Default (1,1,1). It is not a general material brightness fix.

fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: gi_saturation
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original baked-GI grayscale/color interpolation control. Default 1 keeps source chroma; see exact coefficients and clamp in the shader.

fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: sky_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation upper-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; used by actual panorama/light-field or rim helpers where present.

Punch.name: ground_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation lower-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; not an original numeric HE1 material vector.

Punch.name: ambient_light_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation ambient color in lit materials (color picker). A declaration without hint_color is a numeric source-use specialization; the exact declaration and uses below take precedence. Not Godot Environment ambient by itself.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;
fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: sky_panorama
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation 2D panorama used by its five-sample light-field and reflected-direction rim functions. This input is distinct from environment_texture and is not a 4x3 cubemap cross.

Punch.name: ambient_light_sky_contribution
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation interpolation weight mixing supplied ambient with sampled panorama/sky/ground. Use the actual foundation function, including brightness floor and clamp; it is not a generic scene-light intensity.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;

Punch.name: inner_shadow_amount
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation region-shadow strength inside the region; default 1. Applied through compute_shadow and the texture/box mask. With no valid region the shader bypasses this shadow.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: outer_shadow_amount
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation region-shadow strength outside the region; default 0. Not the native DirectionalLight shadow strength.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: inner_min
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation local shadow-region lower bounds, clamped componentwise to [-1,0] in sdBox. Default (-1,-1,-1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: inner_max
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation local shadow-region upper bounds, clamped componentwise to [0,1] in sdBox. Default (1,1,1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: shadow_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation region shadow mask. Red is inverted in sdBox; bind together with the region transform/bounds. Not an HE1 shadow-register dump or an automatically generated engine shadow map.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: region_transform
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation region-to-world transform consumed by compute_shadow. Supply it only for a functioning region-shadow setup; a degenerate axis bypasses the region. It is a real mandatory integration input when that system is used.

compute_shadow: vec3 region_axis_length = vec3(length(region_transform[0]), length(region_transform[1]), length(region_transform[2]));
p = (p - region_transform[3].xyz) * mat3(region_transform);

get_rim_light_color.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

compute_falloff.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

decode_normal_map.reason: The source pixel body has no material normal sample. The linked vertex normal remains the surface basis.

light.reason: Source diffuse uses saturate(N·L), replacing the template's +0.35 wrap. The original Blinn half vector and per-contribution square remain in Godot light(). Source camera specular, where present, also retains the actual foundation fake_specular block with matching material inputs.

source_correspondence.reason: Readable related HLSL is an analysis scaffold with source-absent power sampling removed. Exact original Xbox ASM defines this variant; source-operation tests execute that ASM rather than assuming scaffold equivalence. References below identify real files, not HLSL line numbers attributed to assembly.

source_review: Actual foundation region shadow, custom light(), compute_fresnel cache and fake_specular block retained. Source Common uses unwrapped Lambert and no separate rim lobe; packed material normal decoding is retained when sampled.
The paired Unleashed Default vertex uses 0.3 + 0.7*(1-saturate(NdotV))^5, distinct from SSS Luminescence endpoints and the Generations Default endpoints.

GI atlas encoded RGB is squared before saturation and g_GI0Scale.rgb * g_Ambient.rgb multiplication. Source material diffuse tint affects direct diffuse only; atlas ambient uses texture and vertex RGB without material diffuse tint.
Source P=clamp(power.r*exp2(material.y*10+2),1,512), gain=P/8; source without power map uses 1 and still has material-colored specular. Vertex COLOR modulates diffuse RGB/alpha, not specular.
Original opacity multiplies texture/material/vertex alpha. No emission source or unused emission uniforms retained.
This source has no environment sampler; no environment interface is added.
Original per-light shadow-map selection remains a renderer boundary; preserve established PRR region and native-light integration rather than introducing unbound HE1 constants.
No independent specular RGB map is sampled.
No projected scene reflection sampler.

For absent exact HLSL filenames, a related supplied HLSL is only a readable scaffold. Per-variant original Xbox ASM controls sampler presence, material COLOR absence, additional operations and independent numerical reference tests.

User-requested Common use_gi_atlas defaults false: reuse the actual foundation five-sample panorama and region-only direct shadow. True selects the preserved original baked branch. Material, specular, reflection and per-contribution transfer equations remain shared.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

removed_uniforms.eye_light_attribute: Optional HE1 scene camera range/cone, not an authored material or foundation requirement
removed_uniforms.ambient_shadow_scale: HE1 GI shadow override; retain the foundation region shadow
removed_uniforms.fake_specular_brightness: Accepted Unleashed foundation camera intensity, pre-square; fixed renderer policy

Trans.description: Foundation upper-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; used by actual panorama/light-field or rim helpers where present.

Trans.name: ground_color
Trans.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Trans.description: Foundation lower-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; not an original numeric HE1 material vector.

Trans.name: ambient_light_color
Trans.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Trans.description: Foundation ambient color in lit materials (color picker). A declaration without hint_color is a numeric source-use specialization; the exact declaration and uses below take precedence. Not Godot Environment ambient by itself.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;
fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Trans.name: sky_panorama
Trans.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Trans.description: Foundation 2D panorama used by its five-sample light-field and reflected-direction rim functions. This input is distinct from environment_texture and is not a 4x3 cubemap cross.

Trans.name: ambient_light_sky_contribution
Trans.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Trans.description: Foundation interpolation weight mixing supplied ambient with sampled panorama/sky/ground. Use the actual foundation function, including brightness floor and clamp; it is not a generic scene-light intensity.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;

Trans.name: inner_shadow_amount
Trans.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Trans.description: Foundation region-shadow strength inside the region; default 1. Applied through compute_shadow and the texture/box mask. With no valid region the shader bypasses this shadow.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Trans.name: outer_shadow_amount
Trans.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Trans.description: Foundation region-shadow strength outside the region; default 0. Not the native DirectionalLight shadow strength.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Trans.name: inner_min
Trans.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Trans.description: Foundation local shadow-region lower bounds, clamped componentwise to [-1,0] in sdBox. Default (-1,-1,-1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Trans.name: inner_max
Trans.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Trans.description: Foundation local shadow-region upper bounds, clamped componentwise to [0,1] in sdBox. Default (1,1,1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Trans.name: shadow_texture
Trans.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Trans.description: Foundation region shadow mask. Red is inverted in sdBox; bind together with the region transform/bounds. Not an HE1 shadow-register dump or an automatically generated engine shadow map.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Trans.name: region_transform
Trans.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Trans.description: Foundation region-to-world transform consumed by compute_shadow. Supply it only for a functioning region-shadow setup; a degenerate axis bypasses the region. It is a real mandatory integration input when that system is used.

compute_shadow: vec3 region_axis_length = vec3(length(region_transform[0]), length(region_transform[1]), length(region_transform[2]));
p = (p - region_transform[3].xyz) * mat3(region_transform);

Opaque.name: diffuse_color

Opaque.name: specular_color

get_rim_light_color.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

compute_falloff.reason: The original fragment has no reflected light-field falloff lobe. Its declared terms accumulate directly before vertex color and fog. Keeping the rim term would add a separate view-dependent lobe.

decode_normal_map.reason: The source pixel body has no material normal sample. The linked vertex normal remains the surface basis.

light.reason: Source diffuse uses saturate(N·L), replacing the template's +0.35 wrap. The original Blinn half vector and per-contribution square remain in Godot light(). Source camera specular, where present, also retains the actual foundation fake_specular block with matching material inputs.

source_review: Actual foundation region shadow, custom light(), compute_fresnel cache and fake_specular block retained. Source Common uses unwrapped Lambert and no separate rim lobe; packed material normal decoding is retained when sampled.
The paired Unleashed Default vertex uses 0.3 + 0.7*(1-saturate(NdotV))^5, distinct from SSS Luminescence endpoints and the Generations Default endpoints.

GI atlas encoded RGB is squared before saturation and g_GI0Scale.rgb * g_Ambient.rgb multiplication. Source material diffuse tint affects direct diffuse only; atlas ambient uses texture and vertex RGB without material diffuse tint.
Source P=clamp(power.r*exp2(material.y*10+2),1,512), gain=P/8; source without power map uses 1 and still has material-colored specular. Vertex COLOR modulates diffuse RGB/alpha, not specular.
Original opacity multiplies texture/material/vertex alpha. No emission source or unused emission uniforms retained.
This source has no environment sampler; no environment interface is added.
Original per-light shadow-map selection remains a renderer boundary; preserve established PRR region and native-light integration rather than introducing unbound HE1 constants.
No independent specular RGB map is sampled.
No projected scene reflection sampler.

For absent exact HLSL filenames, a related supplied HLSL is only a readable scaffold. Per-variant original Xbox ASM controls sampler presence, material COLOR absence, additional operations and independent numerical reference tests.

User-requested Common use_gi_atlas defaults false: reuse the actual foundation five-sample panorama and region-only direct shadow. True selects the preserved original baked branch. Material, specular, reflection and per-contribution transfer equations remain shared.

Godot 3.1 uploads scene light RGB times energy times PI. Convert native specular light units once and divide the measured downstream residual: default roughness 1, metallic 0 and specular 0.5 produce Lazarov env=(0.4524,-0.0024), F0=0.04, hence BRDF=0.015696 and retained gain 100 leaves 1.5696. Correct this renderer residual separately from HE1 material math and fake_specular. Foundation diffuse/rim inputs and final specular gain 100 remain unchanged. Material-default writes fail closed pending a revised transfer analysis.

The source camera RGB multiplier and the actual foundation camera constant multiply the individual fake_specular contribution before its square. Preserve this ordering with the unchanged Unleashed default 0.2. The rejected post-square adapter changed I^2 into I and made 0.2 five times stronger in linear output. Source gloss, lobe mixture and final native-light 100 remain unchanged; Generations retains its existing 0.8 path.

Bind original material diffuse RGB as raw Plane values and multiply the sampled texture before the foundation contribution square. Both linear-target and final displayed response are tested; moving tint after the square would apply an unintended output-gamma curve to the material parameter.

Original camera range/cone attenuation multiplies each actual foundation fake_specular contribution before its square, alongside the source camera RGB input. Mode <=0 bypasses attenuation, mode >0 enables the Range.zw distance ramp, mode >1 also enables the Attribute.yz smoothstep cone raised to Attribute.w. Godot fragment VERTEX supplies camera-space distance and forward cosine without HE1 matrix uniforms. Bind range distances in model export units; bind Attribute as raw Plane. Default mode 0 preserves existing callers until original scene camera values are supplied. This does not implement the separate source camera diffuse contribution.

Punch.description: Offset of the GI UV coordinates after scale. Default (0,0); bind original surface atlas rectangle offset.

Punch.name: gi_rgb_scale
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original baked-GI RGB decode scale after source squaring/saturation operations. Default (1,1,1). It is not a general material brightness fix.

fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: gi_saturation
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Original baked-GI grayscale/color interpolation control. Default 1 keeps source chroma; see exact coefficients and clamp in the shader.

fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: sky_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation upper-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; used by actual panorama/light-field or rim helpers where present.

Punch.name: ground_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation lower-hemisphere lighting color. A color-picker input intentionally retained from the foundation; not an original numeric HE1 material vector.

Punch.name: ambient_light_color
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation ambient color in lit materials (color picker). A declaration without hint_color is a numeric source-use specialization; the exact declaration and uses below take precedence. Not Godot Environment ambient by itself.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;
fragment: light_field = clamp(mix(vec3(gray), baked, gi_saturation), 0.0, 1.0) * gi_rgb_scale * ambient_light_color.rgb * base_color;

Punch.name: sky_panorama
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation 2D panorama used by its five-sample light-field and reflected-direction rim functions. This input is distinct from environment_texture and is not a 4x3 cubemap cross.

Punch.name: ambient_light_sky_contribution
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation interpolation weight mixing supplied ambient with sampled panorama/sky/ground. Use the actual foundation function, including brightness floor and clamp; it is not a generic scene-light intensity.

get_light_field_color: vec3 final_ambient_color = ambient_light_color.rgb * (1.0 - ambient_light_sky_contribution) + final_avg_sky_tex.rgb * ambient_light_sky_contribution;

Punch.name: inner_shadow_amount
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation region-shadow strength inside the region; default 1. Applied through compute_shadow and the texture/box mask. With no valid region the shader bypasses this shadow.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: outer_shadow_amount
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation region-shadow strength outside the region; default 0. Not the native DirectionalLight shadow strength.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: inner_min
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation local shadow-region lower bounds, clamped componentwise to [-1,0] in sdBox. Default (-1,-1,-1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: inner_max
Punch.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.
Punch.description: Foundation local shadow-region upper bounds, clamped componentwise to [0,1] in sdBox. Default (1,1,1).

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: shadow_texture
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation region shadow mask. Red is inverted in sdBox; bind together with the region transform/bounds. Not an HE1 shadow-register dump or an automatically generated engine shadow map.

compute_shadow: return 1.0 - mix(inner_shadow_amount, outer_shadow_amount, clamp(sdBox(p, inner_min, inner_max, shadow_texture), 0.0, 1.0));

Punch.name: region_transform
Punch.default_note: No explicit shader initializer; this is not a claim of an authored material default.
Punch.description: Foundation region-to-world transform consumed by compute_shadow. Supply it only for a functioning region-shadow setup; a degenerate axis bypasses the region. It is a real mandatory integration input when that system is used.

compute_shadow: vec3 region_axis_length = vec3(length(region_transform[0]), length(region_transform[1]), length(region_transform[2]));
p = (p - region_transform[3].xyz) * mat3(region_transform);

Trans.name: diffuse_texture

Trans.name: diffuse_uv_set
Trans.default_note: Explicit shader initializer; original material data should override where applicable.

Trans.name: gloss_texture
